summary.content:
Today's selection covers 64 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 39 on Artificial Intelligence and 8 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Meta Unveils New Series of Advanced A.I. Models
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Anthropic, Microsoft
• **Security Alert**: Prominent Ransomware Negotiator Faces Extortion Charges
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 38 articles published in the last 24 hours

all.description: Major TV networks were notified on Friday that the department was examining whether they violated antitrust laws when they suspended pool coverage of President Trump.
